sloka: प्रदक्षिणं रथं कृत्वा आरुरोह निशाचरः।सूतं सञ्चोदयामास शीघ्रं मे रथमावह ।। ६.७८.८ ।।
transliteration: pradakṣiṇaṁ rathaṁ kṛtvā āruroha niśācaraḥ।sūtaṁ sañcodayāmāsa śīghraṁ me rathamāvaha ।। 6.78.8 ।।

translations.english: After having gone round the chariot he (Makara) ascended and said to the charioteer, 'let the chariot be driven quickly'.
